invariants.rationale: A non-null Array<AssetDescriptor> is always created and returned.
An AssetDescriptor is created for every FileHandle returned by getDependencyFileHandles.
If textureParameter is non-null, it is passed as the params of every AssetDescriptor created.
tmxFile is passed as argument and required by getDependencyFileHandles; it should not be null.
Array size is always non-negative by definition.
